about: The demo workspace (Platform Engineering, src/data/platformOrg) as built for the moment below: the records the core rules read. See spec/conformance/README.md.

teams.name: Office of the VP
teams.objective: One plan for the division, reviewed every week, with decisions made where the work is

teams.name: Developer Experience
teams.objective: Make the fast path the easy path, from first commit to merged pull request

teams.name: CI/CD
teams.objective: Pipelines that are fast, trusted and boring

teams.name: Build & Release
teams.objective: Ship any service, any day, with one button and an easy way back

teams.name: Infrastructure & Compute
teams.objective: Compute and Kubernetes that teams never have to think about

teams.name: Cloud Cost (FinOps)
teams.objective: Every team sees what it spends and can act on it the same week

teams.name: Site Reliability Engineering
teams.objective: Restore service fast, learn from every incident, and page fewer people

teams.name: Observability
teams.objective: One place to see what every service is doing, with alerts people trust

teams.name: Security Engineering
teams.objective: Fix what matters within SLA and keep secrets out of code

teams.name: Identity & Access
teams.objective: Least privilege by default, with access that expires on its own

teams.name: Data Platform
teams.objective: Fresh, documented, trustworthy tables for every team that needs them

teams.name: ML Platform
teams.objective: Train, evaluate and serve models without a ticket to anyone

teams.name: Developer Portal, Golden Paths & Self-Service Environments
teams.objective: Anything a team needs, from a new service to a test environment, in one place and in minutes

teams.name: Networking & Edge
teams.objective: A network that scales quietly, with zero-trust between every service

goals.title: Lead time for changes
goals.definition: Median hours from a change’s first commit to it running in production, across every deployable service

goals.title: Time from pull request opened to first review
goals.definition: Median business hours from a pull request being opened (not draft) to its first human or AI review comment
goals.whyHelps: Most of a change’s lead time is waiting for review, so the first review is where the hours are.

goals.title: AI first-pass review on every pull request in tier-1 repositories
Repositories covered by a named review rota
Pull requests under 400 changed lines
Merge-to-deploy time (median)
goals.definition: Median hours from a pull request merging to the change running in production
goals.whyHelps: Merged code that waits for a release train is lead time nobody is working on.

goals.title: Merge queue live for every monorepo

stages.name: Web monorepo on the merge queue
All monorepos on the merge queue

goals.title: Tier-1 services with automated canary analysis
Deploys with five or fewer changes
One-click rollback for every deployable service
Flaky test rate in the main pipelines
goals.definition: Share of test runs on main that fail and then pass on retry with no code change, rolling 7 days
goals.whyHelps: Every flaky failure is a retry, and every retry is twenty minutes of somebody’s lead time.

goals.title: Flaky tests quarantined within 24 hours
Test suites with a named owning team
Pipeline queue wait (p90)
